title: Bounded contexts
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. The rule for work spanning contexts was stated for cuts.
decision: Every concept belongs to exactly one bounded context. Cratylus's contexts are workflow, agents, corpus and delivery, which make the product, and development, which is how the product is made. A story spans contexts only where the same architect holds them; otherwise one story per context, joined by contracts. One architect may hold several contexts, but never merges their models. The workflow never models a user's contexts; users bring their own.
consequences: Contracts and the context map are otherwise unchanged.
